name: joplin-plugin-inline-todo-gui
description: Convert the text at your cursor into an @TODO checkbox with a configurable default due date (calendar picker, or no date at all), tags, and a per-task keyword, in both the Markdown and Rich Text editors. Companion to the Inline TODO plugin (plugin.calebjohn.todo).

scripts.dist: webpack --env joplin-plugin-config=buildMain && webpack --env joplin-plugin-config=buildExtraScripts && webpack --env joplin-plugin-config=createArchive
scripts.update: npm install -g generator-joplin && yo joplin --node-package-manager npm --update --force

author: Frank DeJoy
